value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER or call 911. Hard to wake, sunken eyes, and no urine for 12 hours are signs of severe dehydration in a toddler that can turn dangerous fast.
value.triage: Do not wait or try fluids at home first - get emergency care immediately, call 911 if you cannot get there right away. Health811 (811) is there for advice on milder tummy bugs, but these signs mean go straight to the ER now.
